speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The increase in water prices is not the sole reason for the reduction in household water consumption.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Our water conservation measures, such as minimum water efficiency standards and the mandatory water efficiency labelling of water fittings and appliances, are also important factors.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Over the years, we have progressively expanded the mandatory water efficiency labelling scheme to cover more fittings and appliances and phased out the less efficient ones.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The Public Utilities Board's (PUB’s) household water consumption study last year showed that more than half of the water fittings and appliances used by households are water-efficient models.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will continue to encourage the use of more water-efficient products.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: PUB is also keeping up its efforts in the non-domestic sector.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: These will be resources developed with the industry, for the industry.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Companies have already responded positively, with a number looking to implement water efficiency projects.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Water is a scarce resource that should not be taken for granted ever.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: I urge everyone to do our part to use water wisely, so that we can continue to enjoy it for years to come.

speaker: Mr Speaker
